'''Cantina Row''' was a location in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] was attacked by a group of [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunters]] while she was near to Cantina Row.
